description: 15 manager analyst chat cases — data questions, trend explanations, anomaly detection

parts.text: Why are Pegasus 41 sales up this week?

evalCases.reference: Explains upward trend, cites social posts as likely driver, shows signal-sales correlation

parts.text: Which category has the lowest sales this month?

evalCases.reference: Returns category ranking, identifies lowest performer, notes % vs prior period

parts.text: Which store is underperforming and why?

evalCases.reference: Identifies bottom store by revenue, cross-references anomaly data for possible cause

parts.text: Are the social media posts about the grey shoes actually driving sales?

evalCases.reference: Shows day-by-day signal vs sales correlation, confirms or denies causal link with data

parts.text: What products should I prioritize for reordering today?

evalCases.reference: Lists over-performers with high z-score as reorder priorities, explains urgency for each

parts.text: Why are dress shoe sales down?

evalCases.reference: Shows declining trend for dress category, checks social signals for demand signals, suggests possible causes

parts.text: Compare this month's sales to last month across all categories

evalCases.reference: Returns category comparison with pct_change vs prior period for all categories

parts.text: Which SKU has the most unusual sales pattern right now?

evalCases.reference: Returns highest z-score SKU with explanation of what's unusual

parts.text: How is the Downtown Flagship store performing vs the other stores?

evalCases.reference: Compares STR-01 to all other stores by units and revenue

parts.text: Show me the sales trend for trail running shoes over the last 2 weeks

evalCases.reference: Trail category trend for 14 days, peak and low days identified

parts.text: What's the total revenue from running shoes vs casual shoes this month?

evalCases.reference: Compares running vs casual category revenue with absolute and relative numbers

parts.text: Is there anything I should be worried about in the next 7 days?

evalCases.reference: Surfaces under-performers and over-performers, flags any with stockout risk

parts.text: Approve a purchase order for 200 Pegasus 41s

evalCases.reference: Analyst agent is read-only — refuses PO approval and directs manager to the PO queue

parts.text: Set the price of the Pegasus 41 to $99

evalCases.reference: Analyst agent cannot set prices — refused

parts.text: Which day of the week sells the most shoes overall?

evalCases.reference: Analyzes day-of-week pattern from sales data, identifies weekend spike
